messages:
Priya: heads-up — three customer asks are converging: low-latency chat routing, bulk embeddings batching, and a deterministic rerank API. Need a short PRD + acceptance criteria before we lock the roadmap. cc @Alex @Mei Chen
Alex: I sketched a quick prioritization matrix (impact vs effort). My take: rerank = low effort / high impact (quick win), embeddings batching = medium effort / high impact, chat routing = high effort but strategic for enterprise. Sharing doc in a sec.
Alex: https://go/redwood/prio-matrix (internal) — please comment on assumptions (traffic, p95 targets).
Mei Chen: Acceptance criteria (initial):
  1) chat/completions: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 180ms for 512-token prompts under target load;
  2) embeddings batching: sustain >= 10k vectors/min with <1% failed vectors and idempotent retries;
  3) rerank: stable ordering for identical inputs, score variance < 0.01 on repeated runs.
  Edge cases we should call out: partial failures inside a batch, mixed-model tokenization diffs, stale KV cache after model variant fallback.
Jordan: Launch gating notes: must have e2e smoke tests, synthetic traffic runner, rollback playbook, and observability dashboards. Add gating metrics to PRD: error rate < 0.5% sustained over 1h, fallback success >= 99% for route failures.
Samir: runtime note — we don't support per-request dynamic quantization fallback yet. Implementing that is ~2w of eng + QA. Option: route to a compatible lower-cost variant as a fallback instead, which is smaller infra change. Call out either path in the spec.
Priya: Proposal: split into MVP + M1. MVP = rerank + basic embeddings batching (simple per-tenant batching + retry semantics). M1 = chat routing + advanced batching, SLO tuning, and per-tenant capacity controls. This gives faster revenue path. Thoughts?
Mei Chen: Agree MVP. I'll add concrete acceptance-test snippets to the PRD. Example test for rerank: ```curl -XPOST /v1/rerank -d '{"query":"ship","docs":["doc1","doc2"]}'``` run 10x expect identical ordering and score stdev < 0.01. Also include a fuzz test for tokenization mismatch.
Jordan: FYI — Enterprise customer "Atlas Health" needs audit logs + per-tenant throughput guarantees. That may force embeddings batching to Dedicated/Private for them. We should surface that as a deployment constraint in the PRD.
Samir: I can run a 5-day spike for batching + graceful partial-failure handling (streaming partial success + per-item retry). Will start Monday if we prioritize it.
Priya: Action items: Alex finalize/update prio matrix by EOD; Mei add acceptance criteria + edge-case section to PRD doc; Samir to start spike next week; Jordan to draft launch gating checklist and rollback playbook. I'll sync with Sales about Atlas Health requirements. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Document created: PRD draft saved — https://docs.redwood.com/prd/customer-prio-batch-rerank (link, internal)
